page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU test and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the weak category. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression is poor. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average performance in multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests also show average performance, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can utilize the 32 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, ray tracing, and static web serving, where it achieves average throughput. It is also capable of handling medium-sized language model inference and Redis SET operations at average performance levels. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and the lower single-core performance suggest that this instance is best utilized for parallelized, compute-heavy tasks rather than single-threaded or memory-intensive database applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server featuring 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include bundled local storage or GPUs. Performance benchmarks show a contrast between weak single-core execution and average multi-core capabilities, with the server achieving middle-tier results in multi-threaded stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput also perform at average levels, while single-threaded compression tasks are weak. This instance is suited for parallelized workloads such as software compilation, ray tracing, and multi-threaded web serving, offering a dedicated-core architecture for multi-threaded applications that do not require high local storage capacity.
